title: Two Handed
wikitext:
'''Two Handed''' is a keyword which applies to the use of weapons which take up both [[Main Hand]] and [[Off Hand]] equipment slots. 

Weapons which count as Two Handed:
*[[Bow]]
*[[Staff]]
*[[List of two-handed axes|Two Handed Axes]]
*[[List of two-handed maces|Two Handed Maces]]
*[[List of two-handed swords|Two Handed Swords]]

In almost all cases, modifiers for Two Handed apply only to melee, for example using the phrase "Two Handed Melee Weapons" on a passive skill. See [[Two-handed melee weapon]].

==Passive skills==
===Base passives===
{{Query base passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%two_handed%"
  AND passive_skill_stats.id NOT LIKE "%two_handed_melee%"
}}

===Tattoos/Runegrafts===
{{Drop enabled item table
|tables = tattoos
|join = items._pageID = tattoos._pageID
|where = items.class_id="StackableCurrency"
  AND tattoos.target IS NOT NULL
  AND items.description LIKE "%two%hand%"
|large=1
|description=1
}}
